title.en: THE CLOSETS — THE JOURNEY OF AMBITION

credits.production: Assembled locally (Pillow + ffmpeg) from sources generated with Higgsfield.
credits.stills: Seedream 5.0 Flash (33 frames, animated with camera moves)
credits.narration: Synthetic voice (Higgsfield Text to Speech V2, ElevenLabs engine, preset voice 'Alistair'); the owner's Arabic script with one change ('more than fifty thousand projects'); the sentence pair holding that figure was re-read by the same voice and spliced into the v1 read
credits.music: Generated instrumental (ElevenLabs Music v2 via Higgsfield); no third-party recordings
credits.logo: The official company logo file, composited as is

notes: All imagery is AI-generated illustration. It is not real footage of the company, its people, factories, showrooms or projects.
The film says so on its end card: 'Illustrative imagery generated with AI'.

Facts stated (two factories in Bahrain, more than five branches, presence in Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the UAE, more than 50,000 projects, European machinery, quality and safety standards, digital transformation) were supplied by the owner for this film.

Cut v5 of the all-AI film: identical picture, sound and edit to v1, with the project count changed from 10,000 to 50,000 (narration, on-screen counter, captions). No photograph of a real person appears in it. The 50,000 figure is the owner's statement and is not confirmed in the system.
